messages:
Ruth (Billing): Alert — Orion Therapeutics (acct ORN-718) payment chain failing. Card attempt declined 'issuer_restricted' and incoming wire returned for 'beneficiary_name_mismatch'. Customer asking for next steps to avoid service interruption.

billing-bot: [event] payment.failed id=ch_5Gh8 amount=16800 currency=usd code=issuer_restricted gateway=stripe ts=2030012350

Ken (Support): I spoke with procurement. They initiated wire from their treasury team but bank returned it saying beneficiary name did not match beneficiary account title. They have screenshots. They asked if we can accept a provisional receipt or escrow while they correct details.

Maya (Finance): Two options: 1) Ask them to re-send wire with corrected beneficiary name (preferred), 2) Accept a certified proof of payment and place funds in our short-term escrow account pending reconciliation. Escrow requires Legal sign-off and a manual hold flag on invoice.

Ruth (Billing): I can mark invoice INV-7810 as payment_pending_proof and suspend auto-collections. How long of an escrow hold would Finance need?

Maya (Finance): Recommend 5 business days from receipt of proof for reconciliation, but if Legal okays we can set 10-day buffer for international routing delays. Need Legal to confirm wording for escrow acceptance and release triggers.

Legal-bot: [reminder] Escrow template v2 required for incoming-wire-escrow. Attach: https://secure.redwood/escrow-template. Key terms: release on successful beneficiary match + funds clear, claimant must provide bank confirmation + wire trace. Legal review ETA 24h.

Priya (Sales): Sales note — OriThera is strategic small account. Happy to offer temporary access during escrow if procurement provides signed statement and proof of imminent corrected wire. Approve 7-day access while we reconcile.

Ruth (Billing): Set flags: [payment_pending_proof, escrow_candidate, sales_grace_7d] on INV-7810. Also created ticket to collect bank screenshots.

billing-bot: [event] invoice.updated id=INV-7810 flags=[payment_pending_proof,escrow_candidate,sales_grace_7d] ts=2030012405

Ken (Support): I requested their treasury to upload the bank return PDF and the SWIFT trace. They said treasury can generate a bank confirmation within 24h and will re-initiate wire with corrected beneficiary name.

Maya (Finance): Once we receive bank confirmation and SWIFT trace, Finance will verify with our custodian bank. If everything matches, we'll release the hold and mark invoice paid. If wire fails again, we escalate to manual collection and Sales to consider prepayment options.

Priya (Sales): If they need a short-term workaround, we can accept a prepaid card deposit (via tokenized payment) for 50% to avoid churn while they fix the wire. Offer expires in 48h.

Maya (Finance): Agreed. Action items summary: 1) Ken gather bank return + SWIFT trace (24h), 2) Ruth set invoice flags and pause auto-suspend (done), 3) Legal to review escrow template (24h), 4) Sales offer 50% prepaid deposit window (48h). We'll reconvene after bank confirmation.

Ruth (Billing): I'll log follow-ups at +24h and +72h. Noted. Thanks all. :pray:
